detail.longDescription: South China Morning Post: DeepSeek embarks on ‘unprecedented’ hiring spree as it overhauls back end systems. “Chinese artificial intelligence start-up DeepSeek is embarking on what it calls an ‘unprecedented’ hiring spree to overhaul back end systems severely strained by booming user demand and compute-heavy AI agents.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/08/south-china-morning-post-deepseek-embarks-on-unprecedented-hiring-spree-as-it-overhauls-back-end-systems/
